info.title: InvoiceFlow API
info.description:
InvoiceFlow v4.0 — profesjonalny system zarzadzania fakturami.

Obsluguje: intake (PDF/KSeF/email), deduplikacje, walidacje, grupowanie, workflow akceptacji, eksport do Optima.

Nowe w v4.0: audit trail, deduplikacja, kolektory, grupowanie AI, workflow menadzera, symulator pipeline.

Get unified audit history for an invoice.

timeline. Supports cursor-based pagination and filtering.

get.description:

    - background_processor: "running" | "stopped"
    - cleanup_worker: "running" | "stopped"

get.description:
List all available scenario types with labels.

Returns a list of scenario descriptors including type key, human-readable

Returns:

Raises:
    HTTPException 403: When simulator is disabled or in production environment.

post.description:
Run a scenario through the simulator pipeline.

Creates deterministic test invoice(s) and runs them through available
pipeline steps (collector, intake, dedup, validation, grouping, workflow).
Steps for services not yet implemented are gracefully skipped.

Args:
    scenario_type: Scenario key from SCENARIO_LABELS (e.g. 'pdf_only', 'ksef_only').

Returns:
    ScenarioResult: Contains steps list with status/summary/details per step,
    created invoice_ids, overall success flag, and optional error message.

Raises:
    HTTPException 400: When scenario_type is unknown.
    HTTPException 403: When simulator is disabled or in production environment.

get.description:
Get count of simulator-created invoices.

Queries invoices with source_type='simulator' to show how many
test records exist in the database.

Returns:
    dict: {"count": int}

Raises:
    HTTPException 403: When simulator is disabled or in production environment.

delete.description:
Delete all simulator-created invoices and associated data.

Removes all invoices with source_type='simulator' along with their
related items, versions, and field changes (cascade delete).

Returns:
    dict: {"deleted": int} — number of invoices removed.

Raises:
    HTTPException 403: When simulator is disabled or in production environment.

UserRole.title: UserRole
UserRole.description:
Roles a user can have within a company.

Ordered from most to least privileged:
- super_admin: System-wide admin (not company-scoped)
- admin: Company admin, full access within company
- accountant: Financial operations (invoices, exports, reports)
- manager: Fleet and operational management
- board: Read-only executive dashboards
- viewer: Basic read-only access
